title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Environmental Pollution Criminal Cases

articles.content_en: Article 4: The "loss of public or private property" as mentioned in this Interpretation shall include the actual value of property directly destroyed or reduced by the act of environmental pollution, and the expenses incurred for necessary and reasonable measures taken to prevent the spread of pollution and to eliminate pollution.

Article 5: Where a unit commits a crime under Articles 338 and 339 of the Criminal Law, the standards for conviction and sentencing shall be enforced in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law and this Interpretation.
